trusted_components: frozen Model-1 checkpoint and mandatory hard-state architecture
receipt instrumentation at the consumed z2, consumed z3, and answer boundaries
untrusted_or_adversarial_actions: receipt replay across run, context, execution, or nonce
crossing exact z2 and exact z3 events
substitution across model, checkpoint, protocol, or purpose domains
issuer_trust_limitation: HMAC receipts do not protect against a malicious receipt issuer holding the master key. The bounded claim assumes trusted instrumentation and authenticates committed evidence against post-issuance mutation, crossing, replay, and substitution.
